Resin Art Class Review

I had a wonderful experience learning Resin Art from Pooja Ma’am at Red Art …
Had a great experience with RedArt by Puja. Puja’s resin art work is beautifully done, with a lot of creativity, precision and attention to detail. …

Excellent course at very reasonable price. Pooja Maam is very talented and  has ability to teach the concepts in very simple way. I enjoyed the 10 days program.  I would like to thank  Maam for bringing an Artist in me. Adding few of my art work .
